title: ASN World Convention 2027 — Call for Papers: Nationalism and Empire in the Post-Soviet Space
summary: Flagship nationalities-studies convention with explicit post-Soviet empire streams — the single best-fit venue to debut the matrix.
rationale: Direct intersection of Russian imperialism and decolonization scholarship; individual scholars welcome without institutional affiliation; requires abstract plus travel to New York; field-defining audience.

title: EU CERV — Remembrance call: totalitarian regimes and European memory
summary: Large EU remembrance grant squarely on-topic, but requires an EU-registered legal entity.
rationale: Topical and geographic fit are maximal. Eligibility flagged: applicants must be registered legal entities in EU member states — would require an EU fiscal sponsor or consortium partner. Application effort is substantial.

title: New Eastern Europe — accepting analytical essays on decolonising the study of the region
summary: Open pitch window at the region's leading English-language analytical outlet — ideal home for the flagship matrix-introduction essay.
rationale: Perfect topical and geographic fit; open to external contributors; effort is one 2,000-word essay; respected niche audience of exactly the readers who would adopt and cite the knowledge base.
